takeover.heldByTask: Held by task {id} “{title}” (nothing else can take it over until it's handed back)
takeover.heldByProject: Held by project {id} “{title}” (nothing else can take it over until it's handed back)
takeover.noSession: This {runtime} session is no longer on this computer (it may have been deleted): refresh and pick again
takeover.busy: {busy}: close it there first, or take over a fork (the original stays as it is)
takeover.noWorkdir: The session's working folder no longer exists: {cwd}
takeover.notTakenOver: It wasn't taken over from an existing session
takeover.busyTurn: It's in the middle of a turn: wait for it to finish (or stop it) before handing back to {runtime}
takeover.checkFailed: Couldn't check whether it's open somewhere else ({error}); not taking it back yet
takeover.reclaimBusy: {busy}: close it there first, then take it back
takeover.returnedSend: This session was handed back to {runtime}: take it back in ⚙ before continuing
takeover.prelude.failed: Couldn't read the earlier conversation ({error}); the session is taken over anyway and the history stays in {runtime}'s own records
takeover.prelude.headTruncated_one: Earlier: the latest {count} message from {runtime} session “{title}” (older ones stay in {runtime}'s own records)
takeover.prelude.headTruncated_other: Earlier: the latest {count} messages from {runtime} session “{title}” (older ones stay in {runtime}'s own records)
takeover.prelude.compacted: ({runtime} compacted here: it only keeps a summary of what came before)
takeover.note.taken: Took over {runtime} session “{title}”: {where}. While it's held here, only this writes to the session; to use it in a terminal again, hand it back in ⚙ first
takeover.note.forked: Took over a fork of {runtime} session “{title}” (the original stays as it is): {where}. While it's held here, only this writes to the fork; to use it in a terminal again, hand it back in ⚙ first
takeover.remote.heldByTask: Task {id} “{title}” handed it to the official app
takeover.remote.heldByProject: Project {id} “{title}” handed it to the official app
takeover.remote.notStarted: Not started yet: {runtime} doesn't have this session yet. Say something here first, then hand it over
takeover.remote.stillRunning: The {runtime} process here still hadn't exited after 30 seconds, so nothing was handed over
takeover.remote.handed: Handed to the official app: continue in the {runtime} official app ({url}). Nothing here writes to this session any more; progress over there is copied here as it happens. Turns from while it was held here may not show in the official app. To continue here, take it back in ⚙
takeover.remote.handedNoLink: Handed to the official app: continue in the {runtime} official app (the link isn't available yet; it will show in ⚙). Nothing here writes to this session any more; progress over there is copied here as it happens. Turns from while it was held here may not show in the official app. To continue here, take it back in ⚙
takeover.remote.reclaimed: Taken back: the background session for the official app was stopped, and this continues the same {runtime} session
takeover.remote.send: This session is in the {runtime} official app: take it back in ⚙ first, then continue
takeover.remote.lost: The {runtime} record in the official app no longer lines up (it may have been rewound), so this part wasn't copied
takeover.remote.compacted: ({runtime} compacted in the official app: only part of what came before was copied here)
